page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmgn7ix.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It is powered by a 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor featuring 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 512 GB of system RAM, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 4 GB per vCPU. The hardware setup includes eight discrete NVIDIA A10 GPUs with 24 GB of VRAM per card, yielding a total graphics memory capacity of 192 GB.

The instance incorporates a network interface offering up to 160 Gbps of baseline bandwidth. It contains no attached local storage, requiring compute workloads to interface with external block storage for persistent data access. The integration of eight GPUs combined with dedicated host compute resources provides capacity for parallel computing tasks, though reliance on remote storage transfers requires network optimization.

The hardware profile renders the instance suited for compute workloads including deep learning inference, multi-stream AI video processing, graphics rendering pipelines, and parallel data processing jobs.
